c74object.name: lp.linnie
c74object.digest: Generate linear and triangular random numbers
c74object.description: lp.linnie generates random numbers between 0 and 1 with a linear (increasing or decreasing) or triangular distribution; the options name the slope.

objarg.name: seed
objarg.digest: Seed for the random number generator (0, the default, seeds automatically)

method.name: float
method.description: Map a value between 0 and 1 through the distribution (instead of a random number) and output the result.

method.description: Reseed the random number generator (0 seeds automatically).
